Topic 15.1: Listening and Speaking 15.1.1 Pronunciation and vocabulary
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Listening and Speaking 15.1.1 Pronunciation and vocabulary, part of Caring for others Suggested vocabulary care, listen, special, help, love, sick,  in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade two ENGLISH LANGUAGE ACTIVITIES.

Key inquiry question: Why should we pronounce words correctly? 2- How do we respond to two directional instructions?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. identify words with the letter- sound combinations: - ‘scr-’ as in scream, - ‘spr-’ as in sprain - ‘str-‘as in street, - ‘sw-‘as in sweat - ‘st-‘as in stay, step, stop.

2. articulate words with the target letter-sound combinations as modelled by the teacher, peers or audio recordings.

3. pronounce the new words with the target sounds individually and with peers.

4. practise using the vocabulary in sentences with peers.

5. listen and respond to instructions, without interrupting as modelled by the teacher.

6. role play simple two- directional instructions. 1-

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. identify words with the letter- sound combinations: - ‘scr-’ as in scream, - ‘spr-’ as in sprain - ‘str-‘as in street, - ‘sw-‘as in sweat - ‘st-‘as in stay, step, stop.
2. articulate words with the target letter-sound combinations as modelled by the teacher, peers or audio recordings.
3. pronounce the new words with the target sounds individually and with peers.
4. practise using the vocabulary in sentences with peers.
5. listen and respond to instructions, without interrupting as modelled by the teacher.
6. role play simple two- directional instructions. 1-

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Listening and Speaking 15.1.1 Pronunciation and vocabulary together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Communication and collaboration; will be achieved as learners listen keenly and attentively to specific two-directional instructions.

Values:
Responsibility as learner listens attentively to respond to instructions

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Learner support programmes (peer education) – as learner helps peers pronounce words with the target sounds correctly
